anna: Quick follow-up from the runtime section 94 two asks: a tiny cheatsheet for product on defaults + who owns the rollback steps for kernel updates?

mike: I can draft the cheatsheet. Short version: conservative quant + small batch waits by default, aggressive perf knobs opt-in.

soph: Rollback owner should be Eng-SRE for infra actions, Runtime for config flags. We need a clear playbook.

anya: Agreed. Runtime teams will publish a one-page playbook with commands: `sidecar rollback --version=vX` and `toggle-batcher --off` for emergency.

ryan: Can we add an automatic circuit-breaker if kernel fallback rate > 2% in 10m? That would reduce blast radius.

soph: Good idea. We'll add a canary alert and auto-disable kernel-vX if fallback rate spikes above threshold.

mike: Cheatsheet snippet I will include: knobs (max_wait_ms: 10, max_batch_tokens: 1024, cache_ttl_ms: 300000), canary gates (p99 delta < 5ms, parity < 0.5%).

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: kernel-v4 -> pool-canary-2 deployed: health 3/3

anna: Excellent. Action items: Mike -> cheatsheet (PR by tomorrow), Soph + Eng-SRE -> add circuit-breaker (issue created), Anya -> add rollback commands to docs. We'll close this after PRs land.

anya: Thanks everyone. Short + actionable is perfect.
